claims.text: The authors aimed to investigate the effect of token-level hierarchical position embeddings on summarization performance.
The performance improvements of their HiStruct+ models on CNN/DailyMail were assessed against baseline models to evaluate the effectiveness of hierarchical position information.
The authors noted that the performance improvements on CNN/DailyMail were small, indicating a specific motivation to understand the limitations of their approach.
